feedback: This candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The controller uses a base_speed of 1.35, slightly reduced to improve stability and reduce aggressive driving. The kd gain is increased to 4.0 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations, while kp remains at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain responsiveness and integral correction. Sensor weights are set to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0], increasing the influence of the inner sensors for better steering precision while maintaining balance. The geometry remains unchanged, which is reasonable given no reported issues. Given the limited remaining runs and the lack of telemetry, I recommend approving this candidate to race and provide essential telemetry data on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation. This data will be critical to inform any final tuning decisions and maximize performance on the held-back track. No further changes are requested before racing.
